chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Washa, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Hamza, who said:

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said to me one night while I was in his presence, and he looked at the sky. He said: 'O Abu Hamza! This is the dome of our father Adam (peace be upon him), and for Allah (Exalted and Majestic) there are thirty-nine others besides it, in which are creatures who did not disobey Allah even for the blink of an eye.'
ai.seo_question: What are the thirty-nine domes of Allah mentioned in the hadith of Adam?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) reveals the cosmological structure of the universe, identifying the visible sky as the 'dome' of Adam and pointing to thirty-nine other celestial layers inhabited by creatures who remained sinless. This narration underscores the Shia belief in a multi-layered cosmos where divine perfection is manifested in various realms, offering a metaphysical context for the concept of *Ismah* (infallibility) beyond humanity. It highlights the vastness of Allah's creation and the continuous presence of worship and obedience in unseen spheres.
